paths.description: Homepage: primary discovery and betting dashboard archetype.
İddaa listing: core betting/listing journey and load-time education state.
Membership signup: primary account form, consent, autofill and validation behavior.
Help index: content/support archetype and non-JavaScript discoverability.
Unknown route: HTTP/navigation failure recovery state.

findings.summary: The interface does not adapt to the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition probe reported colorScheme "normal", hasDarkCss false, and the dark screenshot is visually identical to the light screenshot.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), preserving contrast.

findings.summary: Motion is not reduced when the user requests reduced motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found no prefers-reduced-motion CSS, while rendered CSS includes a 9-second animated logo.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential animation in no-preference and provide a reduced-motion state.

findings.summary: Several controls and data labels fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identifies ratios from 2.21:1 to 4.24:1, below the required 4.5:1 for the shown text sizes.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background design tokens and test both normal and forced/high-contrast modes.

findings.summary: Major route and state changes swap abruptly without View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition rules on a multi-route, state-heavy experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route and major state changes with same-document or cross-document View Transitions.

findings.summary: Sticky navigation state is toggled through script-oriented body classes rather than declarative scroll state.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS contains fixedSticky/fixedStickyUp body-class selectors and no scroll-state container-query signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll-state queries for sticky chrome where supported, retaining a light fallback.

findings.summary: Load-time overlays obscure the primary content and flows.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a large consent sheet covering the lower half of the page; the /iddaa path is replaced by a full-screen educational interstitial.
findings.suggestedFix: Make consent compact and non-obscuring where lawful, preserve a clear reject choice, and trigger education in context.

findings.summary: Overlays are implemented as custom structures instead of dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: The recon found 0 dialog, 0 popover, and 0 details elements despite many modal-like controls and full-screen overlays.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal flows and popover/details for transient/disclosure UI with native focus and light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Dense navigation and promotional chrome compete with the core content.
findings.evidence: The first desktop viewport devotes multiple stacked bars plus a banner to chrome before content; the mobile view is similarly crowded.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce repeated navigation tiers, defer secondary promotions, and prioritize the active task and content.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport breakpoints without container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container use across a highly reused card/widget interface.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and container queries for reusable cards and navigation groups.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and many targets are too small.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found outline none on the first visible links/buttons and counted 157 interactive targets below 24px in at least one dimension; Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore strong :focus-visible styles and size/space touch targets to at least 24px, preferably 44px for primary actions.

findings.summary: Load-time overlays interrupt the primary betting and signup journeys.
findings.evidence: The /iddaa mobile path opens on a full-screen explainer instead of the betting list, while signup fields are covered by the consent sheet.
findings.suggestedFix: Let users reach the requested task immediately and present optional education or consent without hiding required fields.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint and interaction readiness are far outside good ranges.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 32.7s, TBT 650ms, and interactive at 32.9s; the trace also measured a 5.09s LCP.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, reduce render-blocking work, and split/defer non-critical JavaScript.

findings.summary: Heavy scripting blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 4.7s main-thread work and 2.2s JS execution; the trace recorded two long tasks and 101.88ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up long tasks, reduce hydration/runtime work, and schedule non-critical work after interaction or idle.

findings.summary: The critical resource chain is large and contains synchronous parser-blocking scripts.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 294 requests and 5.96MB transferred; DOM confirmation shows nine candidate scripts with async=false and defer=false.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, preload only true critical assets, and set durable cache lifetimes for versioned resources.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 1,141KiB unused JavaScript and 354KiB unused CSS, alongside a 630KiB vendor bundle.
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split bundles, remove legacy/duplicate libraries, and load feature code only when the feature is used.

findings.summary: Interactive controls and images lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name and prohibited ARIA; the probe counted 24 unnamed buttons and 8 unlabeled controls, while image evidence found 10 missing alt values.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a semantic name/role, associate labels, and provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: Text and essential UI fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports multiple failures as low as 2.21:1 for visible labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise contrast through shared semantic color tokens and verify all component states.

findings.summary: The document lacks a coherent heading/main structure and visible keyboard focus.
findings.evidence: Homepage has no h1 or main landmark, starts with many empty h3 elements, and focused controls generally compute to outline none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one meaningful h1, a main landmark, logical heading order, and consistent :focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: Target sizing and viewport accessibility are not consistently safe.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size and meta-viewport; the ad-hoc probe counted 157 undersized interactive targets, despite the direct homepage viewport string allowing scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove restrictive viewport variants and ensure controls remain usable at zoom/reflow with adequately sized targets.

findings.summary: Many images lack dimensions or are delivered inefficiently.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 60 missing dimensions, 26 oversized images, and 34 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and serve responsive modern image sources sized to their rendered slot.

findings.summary: Platform hygiene issues prevent fast return navigation and debuggability.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript and a WebSocket-related BFCache failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish valid source maps and close/reconnect real-time channels around pagehide/pageshow where platform support permits.

findings.summary: Some interactive navigation is not crawlable and heading semantics are weak.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found 14 javascript: links, 24 unnamed buttons, and no h1 on homepage/help, though robots and viewport signals otherwise exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigation, buttons for actions, descriptive link text, and meaningful page headings.

findings.summary: Security policy and cookie configuration have avoidable gaps.
findings.evidence: Headers audit found no CSP; cookies audit found one cookie without Secure and all five with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP and set Secure plus the narrowest appropriate SameSite policy on every cookie.

findings.summary: The initial page has a broad tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence observed 23 third-party origins and Google Tag Manager, Facebook, New Relic; HAR attributed 5.86MB to non-main origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory and gate non-essential third parties, remove unused trackers, and load analytics only after appropriate consent.

findings.summary: The signup surface presents password-only authentication without a passkey path.
findings.evidence: Signup DOM exposes new-password fields but no user-visible WebAuthn/passkey action; no permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/sign-in alongside an accessible fallback and request permissions only from explicit user actions.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defense headers are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers audit found no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, although HSTS, nosniff, and X-Frame-Options are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy and migrate clickjacking/XSS defenses into CSP directives.

findings.summary: A majority of rendered content is unavailable to non-JavaScript clients.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 42% raw/rendered word coverage on home and 38% on help, with no h1 surviving as meaningful structure.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core content and links, then enhance interactions with JavaScript.

findings.summary: Custom modal and menu behavior lacks native top-layer resilience.
findings.evidence: Full-screen custom overlays are present while the DOM contains no dialog or popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Move modal/transient UI to dialog/popover and test focus, clipping, edge positioning, and back navigation.

findings.summary: Consent choice architecture visually favors acceptance and hides rejection in body copy.
findings.evidence: The load-time sheet gives large equal-row buttons to “Çerez Tercihleri” and “Kabul Et”, while “Reddet” is only an inline text link.
findings.suggestedFix: Present accept, reject, and granular choices with comparable prominence and no obstructive default.

findings.summary: Signup validation is not localized or programmatically announced.
findings.evidence: Submitting the available form yielded English “Please fill in this field” messages on a Turkish page and no aria-invalid state.
findings.suggestedFix: Localize actionable errors, validate after interaction, set aria-invalid, and connect messages with aria-describedby/live regions.

findings.summary: Signup fields omit useful autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: Signup probe shows identity, email, telephone and several text fields with empty autocomplete; only password fields use new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply standard autocomplete tokens such as name, family-name, bday, tel, email, username, and new-password.

findings.summary: Account onboarding lacks modern phishing-resistant authentication and is obscured by consent UI.
findings.evidence: The signup view exposes password fields but no passkey action, and the consent sheet covers the lower form.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a clear passkey option and keep consent/commitment information visible without blocking required account steps.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bandwidth.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 26 oversized images, 55 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 20 without srcset, and 34 legacy-format assets; Lighthouse estimates 1,185KiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive AVIF/WebP sources, lazy-load below-fold media, and correctly prioritize only the LCP image.

findings.summary: The page performs extensive eager network and background work.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 294 requests including live data endpoints; Lighthouse reports 4.7s main-thread work and 1,141KiB unused JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Fetch visible/task-critical data first, pause live/background polling when hidden, and conditionally load feature bundles.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and media consume a disproportionate budget.
findings.evidence: The load transfers 5.96MB; 45 scripts use 2.28MB, 155 images use 2.17MB, and known trackers include GTM, Facebook, and New Relic.
findings.suggestedFix: Set page/third-party budgets, defer non-essential integrations, and eliminate media and tracker cost without clear user value.

findings.summary: Repeated selection interaction retains a notable amount of additional heap.
findings.evidence: After ten select/deselect cycles, heap grew from 81.67MB/1,456,823 nodes to 85.04MB/1,540,012 nodes; Object count rose from 122,003 to 196,108. Independent-page snapshots add variability, so confidence is medium.
findings.suggestedFix: Reproduce in one long-lived session with baseline/target/final snapshots, then trace retained objects and clean up subscriptions/caches.

findings.summary: The initial page has a very large heap/object footprint.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 1,456,823 nodes and 81.67MB self size before extended use.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce mounted hidden UI, duplicated data, long-lived caches, and eagerly loaded feature code.

taskList.title: Improve rendering performance and reduce shipped code
Fix keyboard, naming, structure, contrast, target size and form semantics
Stop blocking core journeys with custom load-time overlays
Harden CSP, cookies, browser policies and third-party privacy
Make core content and links progressively crawlable
Modernize signup validation, autofill and passkey support
Honor dark, reduced-motion and contrast preferences
Investigate and reduce retained memory growth
